title: Maison De La Mer | Luxurious 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Maison de la Mer is a pet-friendly 30A retreat with a private saltwater pool, golf cart, bikes, Gulf views, and quick access to beach and Gulf Place dining.
description_expanded: Maison de la Mer Luxury Coastal Retreat Steps from the Beach with Private Pool and Gulf Views Home Introduction Unwind in style at Maison de la Mer , a beautifully designed four-bedroom plus bunk area retreat just steps from beach access . Featuring a private saltwater pool, expansive outdoor living, and Gulf views , this tri-level home offers the perfect setting for a memorable 30A escape near dining, shopping, and entertainment. Home Highlights Private Saltwater Pool - Heating available October through April for an additional fee 5 Taxi Bikes - Professionally serviced for your stay 6-Seater LSV (Golf Cart) - Included with stay, waiver required, driver must be 21+ and insured Outdoor Living Oasis - Summer kitchen, gas fireplace, TV, and dining for 8 Fenced Backyard - Fire pit, seating area, and green space for pets Pet Friendly - Up to 2 dogs under 60 pounds with approval and fee Gulf Views - From second and third floor front balconies Beach Proximity - 250 steps to Spooky Lane Beach Access with beach service Gourmet Kitchen - High-end appliances, walk-in pantry, wine fridge, Keurig, and drip coffee maker Dining Seating - Table for 8 to 10 plus breakfast bar for 4 Entertainment - Large TVs with Sonos sound in living room and outdoor area Workspace - Dedicated desk and chair in third floor King suite Laundry - Washer and dryer located on first floor Outdoor Shower - Conveniently located poolside Parking for 4 Vehicles - Driveway parking only, no garage access Sleeping for 12 Guests - 2 King suites, 1 guest suite with 2 queens, twin room, and bunk area Location Perks 2-minute bike or LSV ride to Ed Walline Regional Beach Access with parking, restrooms, and ADA access 2-minute bike or LSV ride to Gulf Place for shopping, dining, and live music 3.6 miles to Topsail Hill Preserve State Park with hiking trails, wildlife viewing, and water activities Minutes to local favorites including Shunk Gulley, The Perfect Pig, and Growler Garage Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for reservations of 10 days or longer and is included in your rate Additional cleanings can be scheduled for an extra fee Concierge services available including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, beach bonfires, beach service, and boat charters Unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor Guest Suite | Sleeping for 2 in two twin beds, TV, walk-in closet, ensuite access to shared full bath with walk-in shower
1st Floor Bunk Area | Twin over Twin bunk, individual TVs for each bunk, underbed storage, hallway access to shared full bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 1 | TV, walk-in closet, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
3rd Floor King Suite 2 | Private balcony with Gulf View, TV, reading chair plus ottoman, workspace with desk and chair, expansive ensuite bath with double vanity sink, tub, and large walk-in shower
3rd Floor Guest Suite | Sleeps up to 4 in Two Queen Beds, TV, ensuite bath with combination shower/tub
